title: Can I read values and properties from .txt files instead of having to write them in RPG Maker events?

posts.author: Annwfn
posts.body:
Hello there, rarely it is that I post questions here, but a request an answer yet again.
I am working on a massive project, or at least the sheer amount of values that I will be using may reach 100k for sure as the game progresses. I am using Makai's Object Properties plugin and am wondering if there is a way to add these properties in .txt files and read them from those files instead of having to write them in RPG Maker events, because that'll mean a lot of space will be occupied just by the scripts needed to add those values.
So, is there a way to read them from .txt files? I know RPG Maker MV reads .txt files converted to .js, or well, the that's how plugins are read. Is there another way, and if not, well, how do I make RPG Maker MV be able to read from external files?
Thank you in advance and happy RPG makin'!
Kind regards,
Annwfn

posts.author: szatkus
posts.body: RPG Maker MV has the `fs` module included which pretty much lets you read any file with a script call. What is the format of that .txt file?

posts.author: slimmmeiske2
posts.body: I've moved this thread to MV Support. Thank you.

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body: I actually prefer using .json files over .txt for external data because then you can use JSON.parse to turn it into objects you can reference in code.

posts.author: Annwfn
Trihan
posts.body:
The way I do it in my game is to have my plugin inject the file into the database (so that it gets parsed into an object the same way as any other game object does) for example:
JavaScript:
DataManager._databaseFiles.push({ name: "$dataCompendium", src: "Compendium.json" });
And then I can just use $dataCompendium to access any data in the file. The structure looks like this:
So then I can do something like $dataCompendium.races_cte and get an array of enemy type strings.
